about.story: Carla Mackey founded Career Connect with a background in education and one aim: to close the gap between what students learn in school and what it takes to build a career. Everyone deserves the tools to reach their full potential, and Career Connect exists to provide the guidance, mentorship and community that make that possible.

services.name: Career Counseling
services.description: One-on-one guidance toward a career that fits your strengths and interests.

image.alt: A counselor talking with a client in a bright office

highlights: Finding the career that fits you

detail.lede: Career Connect helps students and professionals make informed decisions about their education and career paths.
detail.intro: Career counseling is more than advice on choosing a job. It's a process of self-discovery, goal-setting and building a roadmap for personal and professional success. Our counselors work one-on-one with each client to understand their background, preferences and goals, and tailor the guidance to fit.

approach.title: Personalized guidance
approach.body: Every client has different strengths, interests and aspirations. We start by listening, then shape our guidance around the person in front of us.

approach.title: Holistic assessment
approach.body: In-depth conversations and assessment tools help clients see their skills, values and personality clearly, and connect them to realistic career paths.

approach.title: Exploring career options
approach.body: Industry insight and real-world examples help clients understand what different professions actually involve before they commit.

approach.title: Goal setting and planning
approach.body: Together we set short- and long-term goals and build a roadmap that matches the client's aspirations.

whatsIncluded.title: Personality and interest assessments
whatsIncluded.body: Established tools that identify traits and interests that line up with potential careers.

whatsIncluded.title: Career exploration sessions
whatsIncluded.body: In-depth discussions of career options, industries and growth opportunities.

whatsIncluded.title: Goal-setting and action planning
whatsIncluded.body: Clear career goals and a practical plan to reach them.

whatsIncluded.title: Resume review and development
whatsIncluded.body: Resumes that present your skills and experience effectively.

whatsIncluded.title: Mock interviews
whatsIncluded.body: Practice interviews with honest, constructive feedback.

whatsIncluded.title: Professional networking guidance
whatsIncluded.body: Strategies for building a professional network that opens doors.

whatsIncluded.title: Education and training recommendations
whatsIncluded.body: Programs and training that strengthen your skills and qualifications.

detail.closing: Whether you're a student exploring options or a professional considering a change, we'll help you find a direction and a plan to follow it.

services.name: Job Search Support
services.description: Resumes, cover letters and interview coaching that help you stand out.

image.alt: A job candidate in an interview across a desk

detail.lede: Whether you're a recent graduate, changing careers or ready to move up, we provide the support and resources to get you hired.
detail.intro: A job search can feel overwhelming. In a competitive market, the right support makes the difference. We know the job search from start to finish, and we give people the tools and coaching to present themselves with confidence.

approach.title: Tailored strategies
approach.body: Every career path is different. We build a search strategy around your skills, goals and the industries you're targeting.

approach.title: Practical resources
approach.body: From resume building to interview preparation, you get the tools to present yourself well.

approach.title: Market insight
approach.body: We share what employers in your field are looking for, so your decisions are informed ones.

approach.title: Ongoing growth
approach.body: Finding a job is one step. We build in professional development so you keep getting stronger as a candidate.

whatsIncluded.title: Resume building
whatsIncluded.body: Resumes that highlight your achievements and stand out to employers.

whatsIncluded.title: Cover letter help
whatsIncluded.body: Letters tailored to each application, so every introduction is specific.

whatsIncluded.title: Interview coaching
whatsIncluded.body: Preparation that helps you come across as confident and authentic.

whatsIncluded.title: Job search strategy
whatsIncluded.body: How to use job boards, your network and industry-specific resources.

whatsIncluded.title: Application support
whatsIncluded.body: Help understanding requirements and getting your application noticed.

whatsIncluded.title: Career assessments
whatsIncluded.body: A clear view of your strengths, skills and interests, matched to real opportunities.

detail.closing: Let's work through your job search together, one step at a time.

services.name: Internship Opportunities
services.description: Real-world experience that turns classroom learning into a career start.

image.alt: A smiling young man in a workshop apron

highlights: How to find and apply for internships
How to know your skill set
How to turn a job into an internship

detail.lede: Internships bridge the gap between school and the working world. We help you find ones that match your goals.
detail.intro: Internships connect academic learning to real work. They give you practical experience, industry skills and the start of a professional network. We match people with internships that fit their skills, interests and future plans, and support them from the first application to the last day.

approach.title: Tailored matching
approach.body: We look for internships that fit your skills, interests and long-term goals, not just whatever is open.

approach.title: Industry connections
approach.body: Our network spans technology, healthcare, finance and more, so you can explore the field you care about.

approach.title: Skill development
approach.body: An internship should build skills that set you apart. We help you get the most out of every assignment.

approach.title: Guidance throughout
approach.body: From setting goals to navigating the workplace, we're there for the whole internship.

whatsIncluded.title: Internship matching
whatsIncluded.body: Opportunities matched to your studies, skills and career goals.

whatsIncluded.title: Opportunities across industries
whatsIncluded.body: Internships in a range of fields so you can find your direction.

whatsIncluded.title: Skill-building workshops
whatsIncluded.body: Preparation that helps you make the most of your placement.

whatsIncluded.title: Resume and portfolio building
whatsIncluded.body: Showcase your internship experience in a way employers notice.

whatsIncluded.title: Professional skills seminars
whatsIncluded.body: Communication, time management and workplace etiquette.

whatsIncluded.title: Networking events
whatsIncluded.body: Meet professionals and fellow interns, and build lasting connections.

detail.closing: Ready to gain real-world experience? Let's find the internship that launches your career.

approach.title: Genuine connections

whatsIncluded.body: Practical ways to expand your circle through introductions, events and projects.

detail.closing: Starting out, changing direction or widening your circle, we'll help you build a network that opens doors.
